audit_items.proof_trace: BlobRPCMinValidSlot only checks DenebForkEpoch and retention window but never enforces full deprecation after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. The handler continues serving blobs indefinitely as long as they're within the rolling 4096-epoch retention window, violating the deprecation requirement.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After the deprecation epoch, peers can still request and receive blob sidecars via BlobSidecarsByRange P2P RPC for any slots within the retention window, when the protocol requires returning empty.
